A deterministic second-cycle non-Git fixture reproduced initial approved-head trust followed by action current_changed, zero deploy calls, and pin_changed_during_heal despite an unchanged manifest. Six adjacent approved-head and in-lock tests pass, but none combine the non-Git fallback with the second-cycle heal path. falsifier_or_remaining_gap: Add a focused second-cycle drift regression with commit_exists false and the unchanged head in approved_heads; after repair it must reach exactly one deploy call, while removed approval, changed generation, unreadable approval, and unavailable source control remain distinct fail-closed outcomes.
impact: Approved non-Git runtime trees can detect safe drift but repeatedly refuse recovery as a false current_changed condition.

Reconcile or explicitly supersede this narrow fix if issue #2478 changes the trust-root schema first.
